# SAP Cloud Identity Services

## Single sign-on (SAML 2.0)

In the portal, choose **SAP Cloud Identity Services** under Enterprise SSO and **Start with SAP Cloud Identity Services**. Then, in SAP Cloud Identity Services:

1. In the administration console for SAP Cloud Identity Services, under Applications and Resources, choose the Applications tile and choose Create.
2. Enter a Display Name, select SAML 2.0 as the Protocol Type, and save.
3. On the Trust tab, under SINGLE SIGN-ON, choose SAML 2.0 Configuration and use Load from URL with our metadata URL below.
4. Set Subject Name Identifier to Email and Default Name ID Format to Email.
5. Under Tenant Settings → SAML 2.0 Configuration, choose Download Metadata File — or give us https://&lt;tenant-id&gt;.accounts.ondemand.com/saml2/metadata.

### The values the portal shows

| SAP Cloud Identity Services field | Value |
|---|---|
| Load from URL (Trust → SINGLE SIGN-ON → SAML 2.0 Configuration) | The portal's SP metadata URL (`https://…/sso/saml/…/metadata`) |
| Subject Name Identifier (Trust → SINGLE SIGN-ON) | `Email` |
| Default Name ID Format (Trust → SINGLE SIGN-ON) | `Email` |

### What to bring back

Copy **Download Metadata File** — the URL, or the XML — and paste it into the portal's **Metadata URL or XML**. Prefer the URL.

The assertion must be signed, and must carry the person's email address as an attribute or as a NameID in the `emailAddress` format. See [Any SAML 2.0 provider](generic-saml.md) for the details.

SAP Cloud Identity Services's own guide: <https://help.sap.com/docs/cloud-identity-services/cloud-identity-services/configure-saml-2-0-service-provider>.

Then verify your domain and turn single sign-on on in the portal: [Enterprise SSO](../sso.md).
